text:
Ari: FYI - Orchid Edge wants a 5-week POC for their `orchid-edge-45b` variant. Key asks: byte-hybrid tokenizer (nonstandard), 4-bit GQA quant, kv-cache for long chat, 4096-d embeddings for reranker, EU data residency, HSM-backed KMS, and committed per-call pricing with p95 SLOs.
Ben: Catalog quick-check: we have orchid-45b-base but no GQA-quant entry and no tokenizer artifacts. Ask them for `tokenizer.json` + `.model` and a 500-line sample corpus.
Sofia: Note on GQA kernels: our runtime uses a specialized GQA path that changes kernel selection and can increase p95 when seq>2048 or when token id space has high sparse codepoints. We need a token-id diff to confirm kv-cache alignment.
Lukas: Security/legal flag: EU data residency + HSM KMS + retention 180 days = private deployment recommended. If they insist hosted, we'll need EU region + HSM integration checklist and enterprise addendum. Also ask whether inputs include regulated data.
Ari: Action items: 1) Request tokenizer artifacts and sample corpus (sent). 2) Run token-id diff and perf for 4-bit GQA vs fp16 baseline. 3) Draft pricing options (hosted PAYG, short committed pool, private EU deploy). 4) Fill security QS and HSM key policy template.
Ben: Running token-id diff now. Quick script:```bash
# token-id-diff
python tools/token_diff.py --canon ./catalog/orchid-45b/tokenizer.json --remote ./customer/tokenizer.json
# result: 12 remapped ids, 2 new special tokens at high ids (>= 32768)
```
Ben: Observed potential kv-cache offset risk because two special tokens live at >32768; our kv index packer assumes 16-bit ids in some legacy paths. Need remap adapter or run small tokenizer-reencode during ingest.
Sofia: Perf runs (staging base, no remote tokenization attached yet) for ballpark:```bash
redwood perf --model orchid-45b-base --quant gqa-4bit --seq 2048 --batch 4
# p50: 110ms/token
# p95: 420ms/token
redwood perf --model orchid-45b-base --quant fp16 --seq 2048 --batch 4
# p50: 88ms/token
# p95: 260ms/token
```
Sofia: Notes: GQA 4-bit shows a large tail at seq=2048; prefix caching can reduce effective token burn for chat but won't reduce initial generation latency. If they need p95 < 300ms recommend dedicated EU pool or trimmed context model variant.
Lukas: Pricing sketch: hosted PAYG ~ $0.014 / 1k gen tokens; 2x A100-equivalent dedicated EU pool estimate ~$6k/mo committed; private EU deployment estimated setup ~$25k + infra. For per-call committed microbilling we can structure a 5-tier commit with burst credits. Will draft numbers for 100k / 1M tokens.
Ari: Customer replied: they need 4096-d embeddings for their reranker and will send eval queries. They also want HSM key in their AWS account (cross-account).
Ben: Cross-account HSM flow: send them KMS template + principal ARN; devops needs their account ID to set key policy. Also will need network peering for VPC.
Sofia: Embeddings note: projecting to 4096 from our 2048 hidden-state will add ~18-25% latency and GPU cost. Option: run a learned projection head as a POC (cheap) or ask them to accept 2048 for trial. I'll prepare a small adapter example.
Lukas: Compliance: EU residency + HSM + 180d retention triggers legal review; if they process regulated personal data we should require Private with BAA-equivalent for EU regs. I'm opening the compliance ticket.
redwood-ops-bot: Ticket RW-55123 created: orchid-edge-45b POC assigned to #sales, #eng-ml, #eng-security.
Ari: Quick runbook notes to attach: - token remap script to handle >16-bit ids - how to enable prefix/KV caching for chat - fallback options: (1) use orchid-45b-fp16 variant, (2) trim context server-side, (3) dedicated EU pool.
Ben: I'll prototype a remap adapter that rewrites incoming token ids <-> packed ids and test kv-cache stability. If remap works we can avoid re-tokenizing user data.
Sofia: I'll run perf with their tokenizer once they upload the files to the ticket and post p50/p95. ETA EOD.
Ari: POC timeline proposal: week 0 artifacts + security QS; week 1 token-id diff + remap prototyping; week 2 perf + embedding projection eval; week 3 private deploy test (if chosen) + legal signoff; week 4-5 integration + handoff.
Lukas: I'll prepare the EU HSM key policy template and surface the enterprise addendum path to sales.
Ari: Thanks team 8578; I'll send the POC plan to Orchid and ask for their RPS and retention specifics. Update ticket when you post perf results.
